_comment: SOMA-30 joints -> terrorist.glb nodes. Read by tools/make-rig-clip.mjs --map, never at runtime. This rig is hips > legLeft, legRight, torso > armLeft, armRight, head, so most of the thirty joints have nowhere to go.
_chains: Each target composes the whole chain the rig collapses into one bone. Spine1 alone is a 5 cm segment; the visible lean is Spine1 through Chest, so all three compose.
_bindPose: SOMA rests in a T-pose — LeftArm's bind offset is +X, straight out. This rig's arms hang down -Y. The arm offsets are the quarter turn about Z that reconciles the two. Legs, spine and head already point the same way and need none.
_noHips: Hips is deliberately absent. Its rotation carries the captured body's facing, and entity.yaw decides facing here.
